requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the requested value to IWDG_RLR.RL when the function that sets the watchdog reload value is called.
requirements.verification: A host unit test passes when the IWDG_RLR register in the ll_iwdg_regs array contains the value written by the function, and the function returns without error.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall not write to IWDG_RLR.RL if write access is not previously enabled by writing 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: A host unit test passes when attempting to write without enabling access results in no change to IWDG_RLR.RL and an appropriate error code returned.
